note: The practice lab's episode budgets (lab_server.py passes this object to the cell). They must equal the grading run's (verify/grader_config.json), so that practice is the graded episode on another seed: simulated-time cap, camera frames, ticks per step call, settle time before t = 0, the program-time cap (the wall clock minus the cell's simulation and rendering) and silence. practice_episodes_max bounds the practice episodes of one agent phase (a persisted counter).
